content:
Rs. 1000 split among P, Q and R in ratio 2 : 3 : 5. Can your child draw the ten-part bar in their head? Then this chapter is already won. If not, every question feels like a new puzzle. Take the free IMO Class 7 Ratio and Proportion online test below. It has 10 Olympiad-pattern MCQs with instant scoring. Every answer comes with a worked explanation. Aim for 8 out of 10.

What the IMO asks from Ratio and Proportion in Class 7

  • Simplifying ratios with mixed units (2 yr 4 mo : 3 yr 6 mo).
  • Equivalent ratios and finding x.
  • Sharing in a given ratio; continued proportion.
  • Unitary method: price, work, recipes, maps.
  • Direct and inverse variation.

Key facts and formulas to revise first

  • Always convert to the SAME unit before simplifying: 3 kg : 750 g = 3000 : 750 = 4 : 1.
  • In proportion a : b :: c : d, product of extremes = product of means.
  • Mean proportional between a and b is √(ab).
  • Sharing Rs. T in ratio 2 : 3 : 5 — one part is T ÷ 10.

Mistakes that cost Olympiad marks

  • Simplifying 1.2 kg : 400 g as 3 : 1000 (units first!).
  • Adding ratio parts to people counts.
  • Using direct proportion where inverse applies (more workers, FEWER days).

questions.q: The ratio of 2 years 4 months to 3 years 6 months in simplest form is:
questions.explanation: Convert to months: 28 and 42. HCF is 14: 28 : 42 = 2 : 3.

questions.q: If (8x − 4) : (5x + 1) is equivalent to 4 : 3, then x equals:
The number subtracted from each term of 17 : 33 to give 7 : 15 is:
If 5, x, 45 are in continued proportion, the positive value of x is:
If 9 kg of sugar costs Rs. 378, then 14 kg costs:
questions.explanation: 1 kg costs 378/9 = Rs. 42. 14 kg costs 42 × 14 = Rs. 588.

questions.q: 24 workers build a road in 15 days. 40 workers would take:

On a scale map, 2.5 cm represents 125 km. Towns 9 cm apart are actually:

If (a + b) : (b + c) : (c + a) = 6 : 7 : 8 and a + b + c = 14, then c equals:
questions.explanation: Adding: 2(a + b + c) = 21x, so 28 = 21x and x = 4/3. a + b = 6x = 8, so c = 14 − 8 = 6.
